counterfactual_missing_items: The patient denied any trauma history and had no history of connective tissue disease nor any evidence of systemic involvement, such as arthralgia, photosensitivity, or skin rashes.
decisive_items: Direct immunofluorescence: Positive with granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels
predominant lymphocytic infiltrates in perifollicular and periappendageal regions of the dermis and lobular panniculitis
inflammatory infiltrates between adipocytes with hyaline fat necrosis in the subcutis
response.rationale: R2 is favored by lupus-typical lymphocytic panniculitis with hyaline fat necrosis and granular vascular DIF, whereas C1/R3 only capture the linear furrow morphology without histopathologic or DIF support; R1/C2 lack panniculitis and DIF findings. Negative ANA and absent systemic symptoms do not exclude localized cutaneous DLE.

rejected.why: LPP is not supported by panniculitis/hyaline fat necrosis or vascular DIF; dermoscopy lacks broken hairs and histology is not lichenoid perifollicular.
Morphea is supported only by the linear groove; histopathology and DIF are more consistent with lupus panniculitis.
Scalp LPP completion adds no positive evidence and is contradicted by panniculitis and DIF.
Redundant cutaneous completion of R2; its only raw span is a negative systemic finding and adds no diagnostic specificity.
